label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 076 ]

blocks.text: People who are happy don't get everything they want, but they want most of what they can get. In other words, they equip the game in their favor by choosing to value things that are within their grasp. People who find themselves dissatisfied in life often set unreachable goals for themselves, setting themselves up to fail. People who set high goals for themselves and try to reach them are no longer happier than people who set and reach more modest goals.Stay within reality and strive to make things better.

readingSentences.english: Computers have changed our lives in many ways.
readingSentences.korean: 컴퓨터는 여러 방면에서 우리의 삶을 변화시켰다.

readingSentences.english: They help us calculate, store data, and communicate across the world instantly.
readingSentences.korean: 컴퓨터는 우리가 계산하고 데이터를 저장하며 전 세계와 즉각적으로 소통할 수 있도록 돕는다.

readingSentences.english: Yet we must remember that computers are only tools created by human minds.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 우리는 컴퓨터가 인간의 지성에 의해 창조된 도구에 불과하다는 점을 기억해야 한다.

readingSentences.english: They cannot replace human empathy, creativity, or moral judgment.
readingSentences.korean: 컴퓨터는 인간의 공감이나 창의성, 또는 도덕적 판단력을 결코 대신할 수 없다.
